human_markdown: One focused PID Airflow scraper maintenance proposal.

cards.title: Add backoff logging to PID scraper timeout retries
cards.summary: Timeout retries are opaque in recent Airflow scraper runs.
cards.body: Instrument retry attempts and backoff duration for the PID Airflow scraper so operators can distinguish transient source latency from parser regressions.
cards.rationale: Recent cron output showed repeated timeout retries with no per-attempt timing, making triage slower.

source_excerpts.label: cron output
source_excerpts.text: PID scraper retried timeout after 60s; final status succeeded after 3 attempts.

evidence_basis.summary: Supported by PID Airflow scraper cron logs; no authenticated live/browser dogfood verification is claimed.

kanban_task.title: Instrument PID scraper timeout retry backoff
kanban_task.body: Add logging for each timeout retry attempt, backoff duration, and final source URL in the PID Airflow scraper. Include a small regression test or log fixture proving the fields appear.
